result.title: Correcting Flows with Marginal Matching
result.summary: Flow matching models, ODE-based generative models, generate samples by gradually morphing a simple source distribution into a target distribution. However, these models still face challenges in optimally balancing computational efficiency with generation fidelity. While predictor-corrector schemes have been proven to help address this issue in diffusion models effectively, their application to flow matching models remains under-explored. In this work we present a novel training-based predictor-corrector framework for flow matching, which exploits the fact that the ODE can be easily reversed. Our key idea, termed Marginal Matching, is to correct samples at a particular time step in the forward ODE towards a matching marginal distribution of the backward ODE. This scheme proves to reduce a bound on the distance between the data distribution and the learned distribution, motivating two different implementations for the correction function. We show that our proposed method improves sample quality on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-64, with minimal overhead in computation time.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为 flow matching 生成模型提出可训练的 predictor-corrector 框架：在前向 ODE 的特定时间步上，将样本朝后向 ODE 的匹配边缘分布进行修正（Marginal Matching），并给出两种修正函数实现，在 CIFAR-10 与 ImageNet-64 上以较小计算开销提升样本质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「在轨迹中间时刻对状态做边缘分布对齐式纠正」的思路，可能可供核查 latent 推理轨迹中状态纠偏与轨迹训练监督的设计，但论文本身是图像生成采样加速，与视觉推理没有直接关联。
